patches_added.name: Hidden Features
patches_added.description: Turns on two finished Gboard features that a resigned build can never receive: grammar check, and a close control on the chips Gboard offers unprompted. Their flags are delivered per app signature, so resigning the APK means they never arrive and stay off. Both are confirmed working on a device; five other flags were tried and dropped.

patches_added.name: Hidden Features (unconfirmed)
patches_added.description: Turns on four finished Gboard features that a resigned build can never receive: Emoji Kitchen browse, the custom sticker tab, offline translation, and search in Gboard's settings. Off by default because none of the four has been seen working on a device — the flags flip, but each also depends on data Google only sends to an unpatched install. Safe to try: none of them crashes.

patches_removed.name: Hidden: Emoji Kitchen browse
patches_removed.description: Turns on one finished Gboard feature that a resigned build can never receive: browsing Emoji Kitchen rather than only being offered its suggestions. Phenotype delivers flags per app signature, so a patched APK never receives them and the feature stays off. Opt-in: one of these seven stops Gboard starting and it is not yet known which.

patches_modified.name: Suggested Settings
patches_modified.description: Turns on flick keys for symbols, touch & hold keys for numbers, suggestion strip, grammar check and smart replies, and turns off block offensive words and word suggestions. Written once as defaults, so each can still be changed in Gboard's own settings. Grammar check is the switch, not the feature: the row only exists on a resigned build if Hidden Features is applied too.

patches_added.name: NSFW mode
patches_added.description: Adds an option that hides everything except NSFW (18+) posts from the feed. Turned off until it is enabled in Morphe settings. Reddit only sends 18+ posts to accounts that have 'Show NSFW content' enabled, so the feed is empty without that account setting.

patches_added.name: Startup permission requests (before 5002322)
patches_added.description: Requests hand, eye and face tracking, microphone and Bluetooth permissions before opening Steam Link on exact older builds. Battery settings and the visible startup splash are separate patches.

patches_added.name: Startup splash and XR launch mode (before 5002322)
patches_added.description: Adds the Launching Steam Link splash, older-build panel sizing and explicit unmanaged VRLink startup. Does not request tracking, microphone or Bluetooth permissions; select Startup permission requests separately.

patches_removed.name: XR Launcher Bootstrap (Home Space)
patches_removed.description: Installs GalaxyXRPermissionActivity as launcher and configures the Steam Link VR activity XR startup wiring.

patches_modified.name: Device identity
patches_modified.description: Overrides the HMD identity reported to SteamVR. Recommended selects Meta Quest Pro for exact legacy bundle targets through 5002244, including 2.0.20/5001712; otherwise Galaxy XR. The Galaxy profile installs its complete transport identity while preserving stock controller/hand routing and extensions. Optional on 2.0.22/5002322; explicit Quest Pro and Pico profiles populate exact Galaxy XR product entries.

patches_modified.name: Galaxy XR legacy foundation (through 2.0.22/5002244)
patches_modified.description: Selects the 17-patch Galaxy XR legacy set, including Meta Quest Pro identity, native gates, face bridge, OLED calibration, microphone, battery, Visual Delay, explicit startup permissions and splash, and XR foundation. High-resolution output is guarded to verified layouts; unavailable on 5001740.

patches_modified.name: Galaxy XR recommended set (2.0.20/5001712)
patches_modified.description: Applies the 17-patch Galaxy XR legacy set for exact Steam Link 2.0.20 build 5001712, including explicit startup permissions and splash, Meta Quest Pro identity, permission-free high resolution, and the Final balanced tested OLED profile.

patches_modified.name: Galaxy XR recommended set (2.0.22/5002318)
patches_modified.description: Applies the 9-patch Galaxy XR set for exact Steam Link 2.0.22 build 5002318, including separately listed startup permissions and splash/XR launch mode.

patches_modified.name: Galaxy XR recommended set (2.0.22/5002322)
patches_modified.description: Applies the 6-patch Galaxy XR set for exact Steam Link 2.0.22 build 5002322. Preserves stock startup and permission requests except battery settings; includes the Final balanced tested OLED profile.

patches_modified.name: OLED color calibration
patches_modified.description: Calibrates Galaxy XR OLED color and selects a guarded high-precision video output path for Steam Link builds 5001712, 5001740, 5002244, 5002313, 5002318, and 5002322.

patches_added.name: Make system navigation bar transparent
patches_added.description: Sets the system navigation bar to fully transparent.

patches_added.name: Foldable split comment view
patches_added.description: Forces TikTok's tablet-style split layout (video beside comments instead of a bottom sheet) once the screen is at least as wide as a configurable threshold, for foldables TikTok doesn't already recognize as tablet-class.

patches_added.name: Hide feed LIVE button
patches_added.description: Adds an option to hide the LIVE button at the top left of video feeds.

patches_added.name: Hide feed follow button
patches_added.description: Adds an option to hide the + follow button below creator avatars in video feeds.

patches_added.name: Hide feed save button
patches_added.description: Adds an option to hide the save/favourites button from video feeds.

patches_added.name: Hide feed search button
patches_added.description: Adds an option to hide the search button at the top right of video feeds.

patches_added.name: Share sheet modification
patches_added.description: Adds toggles and allow-lists for the video share sheet's "Send to", "Share via app", and "Video Actions" sections.

patches_modified.name: Feed filter
patches_modified.description: Hides feed ads, TikTok Shop items, livestreams, stories, photo posts, the playlist bar, the floating event badge, AI-generated posts, paid partnership and promotional content, posts from verified accounts, videos outside configured view or like ranges, and the countdown lock on short-drama ads.

patches_modified.name: Bypass signature check
patches_modified.description: Neutralizes Smart Launcher's internal anti-tamper signature verification to prevent instant shutdown on launch.

patches_modified.name: Contextual app menu actions
patches_modified.description: Adds a dedicated Archive App entry into the long-press popup menu.

patches_modified.name: Hide archived apps
patches_modified.description: Filters archived apps out of the app drawer.

patches_modified.name: Morphe settings UI integration
patches_modified.description: Integrates the Morphe Patches & App Archiving settings panel into Smart Launcher Settings (under Dev options / Experimental features).

patches_modified.name: Native app archiving
patches_modified.description: Enables system PackageInstaller/LauncherApps native archiving runtime on Android 15+ / One UI 7.

patches_modified.name: Shizuku app archiving
patches_modified.description: Enables Shizuku binder-level privileged app archiving execution in Smart Launcher 6.
